name: My Purpose
overview: God sovereignly directs the purpose of every believer’s life, as His counsel ultimately prevails over human plans (Proverbs 19:21). He has thoughtful intentions for us, desiring to give us a hopeful future marked by peace rather than harm (Jeremiah 29:11). Central to our purpose is the salvation offered through Christ’s sacrificial love, granting everlasting life to all who believe (John 3:16). As God’s workmanship, we are created in Christ Jesus to walk in the good works He has prepared for us, fulfilling His ordained plan for our lives (Ephesians 2:10).
